name: MimicPlay Robot Demonstrations
summary: 机器人部分包含七维动作、两路前方视角与一路腕部视角、末端位姿及关节位置/速度。
summaryEn: The robot portion contains seven-dimensional actions, two front views and a wrist view, end-effector pose and joint positions/velocities.

evidence.statement: The robot portion contains seven-dimensional actions, two front views and a wrist view, end-effector pose and joint positions/velocities. Steps are organized into episodes. Scope is the action-bearing robot portion; human-play videos are not automatically robot motor-command trajectories.
